entry_points.summary: Haiku clustering agent for wide /z-brainstorm runs (WIDE_N > 3). Reads N peer ideator framing blocks from BRAINSTORM.md, clusters them into K distinct directions by core hypothesis / approach axis, returns: K cluster labels + members + representative framing (verbatim), effective-diversity report (N→K, which collapsed), cross-cluster consensus. Read-only; returns text — does NOT write files.

Step 1: read N ideator framing blocks from brainstorm_path. Step 2: distill one approach axis per ideator (≤12 words from Core hypothesis + Framing). Step 3: cluster by approach axis into K clusters (each ideator assigned to exactly one cluster; label + members + representative framing per cluster). Step 4: compile effective-diversity report (collapse names, cross-cluster consensus). Step 5: return structured report text.

invariants: Read-only: no file writes, no shell commands
Every ideator ID from ideator_ids must appear as cluster representative or in Collapsed framings — silent omission is a spec violation
Representative framing is reproduced verbatim (no lossy summarization)
K=1 is valid (all framings share one axis = strong consensus signal); do not artificially inflate K
Cross-cluster consensus section is mandatory even when empty ('None detected.')
Clusterer never picks or recommends a framing — that is the orchestrator's ranked-briefing responsibility

Distinct from scope-reconciler-brainstorm: clusterer operates on the divergence axis (N peer framings, same topic); reconciler operates on chunk axis (HEAVY mode, sub-topics). Do not reuse one for the other role.
Always runs at Haiku regardless of brainstorm.wide_overflow_model config knob
Total wide-mode ideator cap: 9 (1 base wave of 3 + max 3 overflow waves of 2 each); WIDE_N > 9 silently capped
gotchas: Caller integration: on clusterer failure or K=0, /z-brainstorm falls back to presenting N raw framings in the Phase 3 ranked briefing — never halts
Two framings that share the same core tradeoff but use different vocabulary are one cluster (do not over-split)
Two framings that make genuinely conflicting architectural bets stay separate (do not over-merge)
OVERFLOW_MODEL applies only to general-purpose (Claude) overflow ideator slots; the clusterer itself always runs at Haiku regardless of overflow model setting
Caller passes brainstorm_path (abs path to BRAINSTORM.md), ideator_ids (JSON array in wave order), and n (total ideator count)
Wide mode: Phase 3 briefing uses CLUSTER_BLOCKS (K cluster directions) not N raw framings when CLUSTER_K > 0
Non-supporting drivers (cursor, codex flat) skip clusterer Agent() call entirely per RUNTIME-GATE comment in z-brainstorm.md; fall back to N raw framings
Phase 2c-5 dispatches clusterer only after all overflow waves complete and BRAINSTORM.md contains all wave framing blocks
